title: Discovery of Lake Vostok
summary: Lake Vostok, a lake lying beneath the ice of central East Antarctica, is the largest Antarctic subglacial lake. NASA says it was discovered in 1996 with a radar on the European ERS-1 satellite. A review cites a 1996 paper by Kapitsa and colleagues reporting the water at least 500 m deep, and describes the lake as about 250 km long.

uncertainty.note: NASA states 1996 as the discovery year. The Phil. Trans. review also cites ERS-1 altimetry work from 1993 and radio-echo sounding from 1977, so earlier milestones exist.
